guidebook.intro: Folktales and their lessons. **Imba fe ama ni** (it teaches us) draws the moral.

tips.title: O’bi ka ondru
body: **O’bi** is the hare (Wakayima in Luganda), **ondru** the hyena. **O’bi ozi ewa ra** (the hare tricked the elephant).

tips.title: Imba fe ama ni
body: **E’yo ati nde imba fe ama ni ngo?** (what does this story teach us?) — **ka ozi ega okpo dria** (that wisdom beats strength).
The Kintu and Nnambi legend is from Buganda, retold here in Lugbara.

culture.title: Lugbara origins
body: Lugbara tradition tells of the first ancestors, Jaki and Dribidu, whose descendants became the Lugbara clans.
